mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.article_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.reply_to_id, c.content, c.create_time, u.nickname AS author_name, u.avatar AS author_avatar, ru.nickname AS reply_to_name FROM `comment` c LEFT JOIN blog_user u ON u.id = c.user_id -- reply_to_id 指向的是被回复的评论，需再回表取其作者昵称 LEFT JOIN `comment` rc ON rc.id = c.reply_to_id LEFT JOIN blog_user ru ON ru.id = rc.user_id WHERE c.article_id = #{articleId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `comment` WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND status = 1
